purpose: Illustrated Ink replay segmentation and prompt controls for a Sa'ueia route assembly testing ecological standing and redress at Low Bend.

visual_scene_plan.purpose: Click-through visual anchors for Low Bend's public geometry, routine signal preparation, mirror-amoeba discovery, evidence gathering, standing tests, remedy threshold, and four state-gated ending families.
visual_scene_plan.segmentation_rule: Use separate anchors for establishing geometry, participant introduction, routine preparation, folded record, contamination reveal, evidence work, standing challenge, remedy threshold, and each ending family. Branch choices with durable visible consequences use modifiers on the next shared scene and ending frames.
visual_scene_plan.prompting_rule: Each base image prompt is a complete standalone frame for a general image model. It describes visible geometry, materials, light, bodies, and objects in plain language and includes only participants visible in that frame.
visual_scene_plan.global_style_cue: Style: hand-painted ecological science-fantasy storybook frame, layered gouache and ink textures, restrained cold blues and amber bioluminescence, silver-green wetland color, sharp readable silhouettes, tactile living infrastructure, expressive nonhuman body language, cinematic composition designed for illustrated interactive fiction.
visual_scene_plan.prompt_assembly_rule: Assemble every image prompt from global_style_cue, the selected scene base_image_prompt, visual refs only for named characters and groups visible in that frame, and triggered state or branch modifiers. Continuity notes remain reviewer constraints. Each generation receives a camera-specific scene-set blockout when high-consistency replay art is produced.

scene_set_guidance.scope_reason: The fixture revisits one crossing from several focal distances and branches alter lane lighting, cargo position, ant traces, courier presence, herd position, and archive state. A stable map is required even for draft prompt planning.
scene_set_guidance.future_scene_set_need: Build a plan-view or low-detail 3D blockout of Low Bend from the scene_set zones and camera slots before high-consistency website rendering. Use generated images only as painterly output over that geometry.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Wide elevated establishing view of Low Bend on a dim alien world during eclipse ingress. A narrow amber fungal road descends from the upper right between three thick lantern trees and reaches a dry crescent-shaped stone hearing shelf at center. Cold blue bioluminescent knots hang beneath the tree canopies. A shallow river runs from the upper left across the lower frame toward a mineral reef mouth in the far left distance. Silver-green prism-patterned living mats tile the shallow ford. Two passages leave the shelf: a dry root lane curves beneath the trees, and a wet ford lane crosses the mats before both rise toward a distant route. On the central shelf, a long-bodied six-limbed Sa'ueia route reader rests low beside pale route cords, a black stone water basin seated in a thumb-wide runnel from the river, and layered flexible archive membranes on a ribbed work frame. Umbros, an enormous dark neighboring world, hangs fixed in the sky while shadow begins to cover the sun.

visible_characters.default_stance: resting low at the center of the crescent shelf with chest manipulators beside cords and archive frame

visual_continuity_notes: Current direction runs upper-left to lower-left toward the distant reef mouth; the upland fungal road enters from upper-right.
Root lane and ford lane diverge at the crescent shelf and rejoin beyond the crossing.
Sa'ueia anatomy is hexapodal: four tall digitigrade running legs and two smaller three-digit chest manipulators.

visual_character_refs.purpose: Stable named-character and group visual identities for prompt assembly. Include only refs for participants visible in a rendered frame.

characters.seyr_path_opener: Seyr: adult Sa'ueia route reader, long-bodied hexapod with four tall digitigrade running legs folded or planted beneath the torso and two smaller chest limbs ending in three soft opposing digits; short pale-gray insulating fibers over charcoal hide; two broad chemical-sensing facial fans striped cream and rust; narrow wedge-shaped head; balanced slate-blue flank straps; calm low posture and precise chest-hand gestures; one thin white scar across the right facial fan.
characters.ili_record_keeper: Ili: elderly Sa'ueia archive keeper, long-bodied hexapod with four sturdy digitigrade running legs and two small three-digit chest manipulators; dark umber hide under sparse silver fibers; left chemical-sensing facial fan healed into a permanent crooked fold; pale archive cords looped across the flank; compact resting posture near low work surfaces; dry attentive expression carried through fan angle and head tilt.
characters.varet_claimant: Varet: younger adult Sa'ueia route traveler, long-bodied hexapod with four lean digitigrade running legs and two three-digit chest manipulators; copper-brown hide under cream-and-black short fibers; paired facial fans with dark blue edges; balanced woven flank frame holding sealed pale graft bundles; alert forward posture, frequent glances between herd, lanes, and record.

groups.unindebted_signal_bearers: Two adult Sa'ueia route readers from different families, each a long-bodied hexapod with four digitigrade running legs, two smaller three-digit chest manipulators, wedge-shaped head, and paired chemical-sensing facial fans. One wears moss-green flank cords at the amber fungal candle station; the other wears river-blue cords at the black water basin. Their bodies remain visibly separated at different signal sources.
groups.low_bend_glassback_herd: Small herd of stocky alien quadruped grazers with broad muzzles, dark flexible hides, and tall translucent dorsal plates covering living heat-storage tissue. Plate colors show cloudy amber warmth, dark stress, and pale route confidence. One visibly pregnant dam has a low heavy abdomen and a blue woven pack frame that can be removed; the herd communicates by broadside display, flank spacing, stamping, and lane approach.
groups.witness_threadwing: One small alien courier animal with a narrow gliding body, hooked perching feet, and several long ribbonlike sensory vanes in place of feathered wings. The vanes shimmer cream, blue, and mineral silver; a braided route loop can carry a salt bead, sealed water droplet, or rolled translucent record. Body language uses vane flutter, head angle, gripping, launch, and refusal to land.
groups.diagnostic_lattice_ants: A colony of tiny black jointed insects that lock their bodies into a flexible bridge or net over wet ground. Pale shed fibers and translucent microbial glue connect them into a temporary circuit; chemical history appears as silver, amber, and dark stains traveling through the assembled mesh.
